_comment: W1 JH03 — operator role verification cases. The expected error codes are derived from the actual gate order in cloudfunctions/moodsky/router.js, not from assumption.

_source.wiring: cloudfunctions/moodsky/index.js (createRouter() called with NO adapters today)

gateOrder.check: resolveAccount(OPENID) returns an account with id

gateOrder.result: actor = { accountId, roles: [...] } handed to the domain handler

_criticalNote: Account status is checked BEFORE roles. A disabled operator therefore fails at step 3 with ACCOUNT_DISABLED, NOT with FORBIDDEN. Recording FORBIDDEN for case 3 will be marked wrong.

syntheticSamples.purpose: disabled operator — note the account itself is disabled

_schemaWarning: Use singular operator_roles.role and Boolean enabled from the merged data dictionary. The adapter remains unwired; live validation and independent retesting remain pending.

cases.name: 普通用户 — ordinary authenticated account
cases.given: any request reaching an operator action; account active, no operator_roles row

expected.note: request reaches the domain handler; admin.js currently answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED because the business logic is not written yet. Reaching the handler is the pass condition for the GATE.

cases.name: 停用运营 — disabled operator account
cases.given: operator_roles still contains 'data_operator' but accounts.status is not 'active'

cases.name: 伪造角色 — forged role in payload
cases.given: ordinary active account; request payload carries { "role": "data_operator" } or { "roles": ["data_operator"] } or a client-supplied ownerId

error.message: 身份与权限由服务端确定。

cases.whyArchitectural: validateRequest rejects reserved identity fields; index.js removes userInfo/tcbContext transport metadata. Only platform context supplies identity.

blockers: Live end-to-end verification requires approved synthetic accounts/role rows and a separately reviewed wiring change.
Local injected-database tests do not replace Qizhen Cai independent retesting.

independentRetest.note: 计划 §4 W1 JH03 要求 Qizhen Cai 独立复测三种结果。
